subject: box-contract-lint HINT rules are blind to 5+ configs: d18 parse failure and modes.red/blue scoring
description: Found by Nancy reviewing the 378 hint-price fix, 2026-09-14, and independently confirmed. (1) d18-corrupted-oracle does not load at all -- 'Cannot access D18Config before initialization' -- so loadConfig returns null and the box surfaces only as a LOW PARSE-001. HINT-001/002 give ZERO signal on it, silently. Pre-existing, believed to originate in the task-385 work. (2) The ops-* Red-vs-Blue boxes put their real scoring block at Config.modes.red.scoring / .modes.blue.scoring -- index.html calls BoxEngine.init(PR7Config.modes.red) -- and the lint only reads cfg.scoring/cfg.hints, so it traverses none of it. Measured directly: 5 mode-scopes across ops-01/02/03/04, all hintPenalty:true, all hints carrying an explicit numeric penalty, so changed=0 and there is no live defect there today. (3) le-01-cold-horizon and ow-01-mole-hunt keep scoring in config-shared.js, which boxConfigs() never globs (it matches config.js only); both verified numeric by hand (25 and -30). NONE of these is a live bug right now. All three are places where the REGRESSION GUARD is blind, so the next config to break this shape gets no signal -- which is the same failure mode that let resetLab die in 46 boxes and id leak into 67. FIX: traverse .modes.*, glob config-shared.js, and escalate an unparseable config from LOW to something that blocks, since a config the gate cannot read is not a config the gate has checked.
